entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajnish Ojha,Deepanjali Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Rajnish Ojha, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Rishikesh Verma, the learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No. 34 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kohdaur, District Pratapgarh.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 19.03.2023, against the applicant and one Kamesh Umar Vaishya, stating that the co-accused runs a tiny branch of Bank of Baroda.

The informant had given his A.T.M. card to the accused persons for withdrawing Rs.
5,000/- but they made an extra withdrawal of Rs. 5,000/-.

The applicant has also alleged that the operator of the tiny branch of the Bank fraudulently withdrawn Rs. 1,35,000/- from his bank account but no particulars of the alleged withdrawal have been mentioned in the F.I.R.

entities.text:
F.I.R.
Rajan Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application it has been contended that the applicant is innocent, he has no criminal history and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
5. It has been stated that the co-accused-Kamesh Umar Vaishya, who is said to be the operator of the tiny branch of Bank, has already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in Criminal Misc.
Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2890 of 2023 by means of an order dated 18.12.2023.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

Vidyarthi,J.] Order Date :- 12.7.2024 Ruhi H.
